description: The only `open` event of connection 1 is BAD_EVENT (feed missing or not FORCE / KLINE), so the connection has no valid open event and its message is MSG_CONN_UNKNOWN. No SLOT in this journal (r5 would treat the CONN event as valid, so the replay of r5 and r6 differ by design here).
title: a CONN event without feed is BAD_EVENT
